title: People’s Mañanera October 8
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Public Companies of the 4T Are Making Progress and Delivering Results  
** The Felipe Angeles International Airport (AIFA) served 22.6 million
passengers; Mexicana carried 1.27 million and doubled its fleet; the Mayan
Train transported 2.94 million. President Claudia Sheinbaum noted that state
owned enterprises operate with clear goals and financial self-sufficiency.

**The Recovery of the Railways: A Hallmark of the Fourth Transformation  
** After decades of neglect and privatization, former president Andrés Manuel
López Obrador reclaimed the passenger rail system. Today, the Mayan Freight
Train, the Interoceanic Corridor, and new rail routes are moving forward.
Sheinbaum explained that “the revival of the railways is a hallmark of the
Fourth Transformation.”

**Morena Celebrates 15 Years of Accompanying the People  
** Sheinbaum celebrated Morena’s 15th anniversary and called on its members to
uphold the principles that gave rise to the movement. “It is the movement
closest to the people—I would say perhaps the most important in the world,”
the President declared.

**Cooperation with the United States, Always with Sovereignty  
** The President reiterated that all security cooperation must respect Mexican
laws, a position acknowledged by the U.S. ambassador. In Chihuahua, the
Federal Attorney General’s Office (FGR) is investigating whether CIA agents
violated the law by participating in the dismantling of a clandestine drug
laboratory.
